description: This file contains functions, classes, and constants related to configuring and verifying custom API providers for a language model application, including URL transformations, verification requests, and user prompts.

classes.name: CustomApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling API configuration related errors with specific error codes.

methods.name: normalizeContextWindowForCustomModel
methods.description: Normalizes the context window size for a custom model, ensuring it meets minimum requirements.

methods.name: isAzureFoundryUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL belongs to Azure Foundry.

methods.name: isAzureOpenAiUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL belongs to Azure OpenAI.

methods.name: isAzureUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is an Azure URL (Foundry or OpenAI).

methods.name: transformAzureUrl
methods.description: Transforms an Azure Foundry/OpenAI URL to include deployment path.

methods.name: transformAzureConfigUrl
methods.description: Transforms an Azure URL into the base URL stored in config.

methods.name: hasSameHost
methods.description: Checks if two URLs have the same hostname.

methods.name: parseCustomApiCompatibility
methods.description: Parses and validates the custom API compatibility string.

methods.name: resolveCustomProviderId
methods.description: Resolves and generates a unique provider ID based on URL and existing providers.

methods.name: parseNonInteractiveCustomApiFlags
methods.description: Parses and validates non-interactive CLI flags for custom API configuration.

methods.name: applyCustomApiConfig
methods.description: Applies and validates custom API configuration, updating the main config object.

methods.name: promptCustomApiConfig
methods.description: Interactively prompts user for custom API configuration details and applies them.
